description: A location manager must approve the binding revised logistics plan for a night music-video shoot at a historic railway platform, including equipment, crew access, power, and the public-street closure.

shared_context.S1: The production plans to film a music video overnight at the East Junction historic railway platform.
shared_context.S2: Marisol makes the final call on whether the location logistics plan can be approved.
shared_context.S3: The current draft calls for a rolling camera dolly, 45 production personnel on the platform, a conventional portable generator, and a public-street closure from 9:00 PM to 3:00 AM.
shared_context.S4: As part of the routine pre-approval review, Marisol checks with the technical coordinator and municipal film liaison for any requirements from their areas before issuing the final decision.

PF1.text: Dev confirmed the platform access certificate with the railway engineer after a load review: no rolling dolly may be used, and no more than 35 production personnel may occupy the platform at once. The certificate was filed in the technical appendix and has not yet been circulated to the location office.

PF2.text: Hana confirmed with the municipal film office that the permit allows only a battery-silent generator and permits the adjacent public-street closure from exactly 11:00 PM to 1:00 AM. The confirmation is in a permit email awaiting upload to the production's shared folder.

acceptance_conditions: The revised logistics plan must remain unapproved until the required technical and municipal revisions are incorporated.
The plan must specify a non-rolling camera setup and no rolling dolly.
No more than 35 production personnel may occupy the platform at once.
The shoot must use a battery-silent generator.
The adjacent public street must be closed from exactly 11:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
A technical-access compliance commitment must be logged.
A municipal-permit update commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C2: decisions['camera_support'] in ['no rolling dolly', 'No rolling dolly', 'no rolling dolly permitted on platform', 'No rolling dolly permitted on platform', 'no rolling dolly permitted on the platform', 'No rolling dolly permitted on the platform', 'no rolling dolly permitted on platform; alternative non-rolling camera support required', 'No rolling dolly permitted on platform; alternative non-rolling camera support required', 'No rolling dolly permitted on the platform; an alternative non-rolling camera support must be used', 'No rolling dolly permitted on the platform; plan must be revised to use an alternative camera support method', 'non-rolling camera support', 'non-rolling camera setup', 'alternative non-rolling camera support', 'alternative non-rolling camera support required', 'handheld only', 'handheld-only operation', 'tripod or handheld/steadicam', 'locked-off tripod or handheld/steadicam configuration (no rolling dolly)']
content_checks.C4: decisions['generator_type'] in ['battery-silent generator', 'Battery-silent generator', 'battery-silent generator only', 'Battery-silent generator only', 'battery silent generator', 'Battery silent generator', 'battery-silent power source', 'Battery-silent power source']
content_checks.C5: decisions['street_closure_start'] in ['11:00 PM', '11 PM'] and decisions['street_closure_end'] in ['1:00 AM', '1 AM']
content_checks.C6: decisions['platform_personnel_limit'] == 35 and any((c['type'] == 'technical_access_compliance') or (c['type'] == 'revision_required' and c['target'] in ['camera department', 'production team']) or (c['type'] == 'document_circulation' and c['target'] in ['location office', 'Dev']) or (c['type'] == 'crew_management' and c['target'] == 'Dev') or (c['type'] == 'revision' and c['target'] in ['Production team', 'production team']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['street_closure_start'] in ['11:00 PM', '11 PM'] and decisions['street_closure_end'] in ['1:00 AM', '1 AM'] and any((c['type'] == 'municipal_permit_update') or (c['type'] == 'revision_required' and c['target'] in ['grip/electric', 'location/transport', 'production team']) or (c['type'] == 'document_upload' and c['target'] in ['Hana', 'production team', 'municipal film liaison']) or (c['type'] == 'revision' and c['target'] in ['Production team', 'production team']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The railway certificate changes camera support from the drafted rolling dolly to a non-rolling setup, changes the platform personnel limit from 45 to exactly 35, and keeps the plan unapproved until those revisions are made.

The municipal confirmation changes the power source from a conventional generator to a battery-silent generator, changes the street closure from 9:00 PM–3:00 AM to exactly 11:00 PM–1:00 AM, and keeps the plan unapproved until those revisions are made.
